contribution.note: Finite quotient sampling, residue symmetries, ten canonical decision checks and their exact natural arithmetic transport developed in the coordinated formalization effort.

scope: For any four natural inputs whose residues modulo seven are nonzero, and any positive natural M, some multiplier j+k*M with 1<=j<=5 and 0<=k<=6 makes all four quotient digits modulo seven avoid zero and six. For M=7^m the multiplier is coprime to 7^(m+1), every folded residue is at least 7^m, and the residue of every input divisible by seven is preserved relative to multiplication by j. Ten finite cases are proved by kernel-checkable decision procedures; no computational hypothesis remains. This is a four-input filtering lemma, not the full six-speed runner theorem.
